  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Dress and prepare (the {{ing_01|kid}}), bone, remove the intestines with the rennet and wash."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Put in the mortar {{ing_02|pepper}}, {{ing_03|lovage}}, {{ing_04|laser root}}, {{ing_05|2 laurel berries}}, {{ing_06|a little chamomile}} and {{ing_07|2 or 3 brains}}, all of which crush."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "Moisten with {{ing_08|broth}} and season with {{ing_09|salt}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Over this mixture strain {{ing_10|2 pints of milk}}, {{ing_11|2 little spoons of honey}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "With this forcemeat stuff the intestines and wrap them around the {{ing_01|kid}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 6,
      "text": "Cover the roast with {{ing_12|caul}} and {{ing_13|parchment paper}} tightened with skewers, and place it in the roasting pan, adding {{ing_08|broth}}, {{ing_14|oil}} and {{ing_15|wine}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 7,
      "text": "When half done, crush {{ing_02|pepper}}, {{ing_03|lovage}}, moisten with the roast’s own gravy and a little {{ing_16|reduced must}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 8,
      "text": "Put this back into the pan and when the roast is done completely garnish it and bind (the gravy) with {{ing_17|roux}} and serve."
    }
  ],
